name: Specialized Engines
objective: Complete 3 specialized calculation engines (Numerology, Biorhythm, Biofield) by filling feature gaps, adding missing calculation systems, refactoring to canonical file structure, hardening with comprehensive tests and benchmarks, and updating workflow integrations.
context: All three engine crates exist with substantial implementations. Numerology has Pythagorean/Chaldean core numbers. Biorhythm has primary + intuitive cycles with forecast. Biofield has Vedic chakra analysis with mock fallback. This plan closes the remaining feature gaps, normalizes structure, and brings all three to production quality.
gate: Gate V2.2.0: All 3 engines pass ConsciousnessEngine contract tests, reference validation suites, and p95 benchmarks under 5ms. Workflows updated. API docs complete.
